regions.text: 成に於て月が遣られなかつた場合を考へても必ずしも不合理ではない。地球も造られず人間も生じなかつた場合を考へても、それが不合理であるとは云へない。

quote.translation: If we think instead of the case in which, in the formation of the universe, the moon was never made, this is not necessarily irrational, and even if we think of the case in which the earth too was never made and man never arose, it cannot be called irrational.

regions.text: 天文學は、月が地球に對して除りに大きく惑屋の衝屋として寧ろ例外であることを教へ、また、恆星が重星とならないで、一個の太陽を中心として諸惑星が廻槫してゐる我々の太陽系が、恆星生成の法則に例外をなすことを教へてるる。

quote.translation: Astronomy teaches that the moon is too large in relation to the earth and is, as the satellite of a planet, something of an exception, and it teaches also that our solar system, in which the star did not become a multiple star and the planets revolve around a single sun as their centre, is an exception to the law of the formation of fixed stars.

regions.text: 「進化論が動物から人間への進化を説く背景にも人間への進化が行はれず瀬人猿が生物發展の頂點をなす可能性の知きものをも考へてある筈である。

quote.translation: Behind the theory of evolution's account of the evolution from animals to man, too, there must be the thought of something like the possibility that the evolution to man did not take place and that the anthropoid apes formed the summit of biological development.

regions.text: 更に哲學が「無に開する考察をなす場合にも排中律による離接關係を或は何等か超論理的な思催可能性を豫想してゐなければならない。フッサールも次のやうに云ってゐる。

quote.translation: And when philosophy undertakes a consideration of "nothingness", it must presuppose the disjunctive relation given by the law of excluded middle, or else some supra-logical possibility of thought.

regions.text: 『経驗を悲礎づける認識作用は現實を個的に措定する。空間的時間約に實存するものとして措定する。この時間位置に在つてこの持療と一定の現實内容とを有つ或るものとして措定する。きうしてその現實内容はその本質に従つて如何なる他の時間位置にもあり得たものである。

quote.translation: Husserl too says: "The cognitive acts that found experience posit the actual individually; they posit it as existing in space and time, as something that is at this position in time and has this duration and a determinate actual content, and that actual content, according to its essence, could equally have been at any other position in time.

regions.text: またこの場所に一定の物理的形態に於て在る或るものとして措

quote.translation: They posit it, again, as something that is at this place in a determinate physical form , and that same actuality, according to its essence, could equally have been at any place whatever and in any form whatever.
